_doc: Step-5 parameter registry (docs/step5-plan.md section 5). The ONLY place a step-5 number may live. Every entry: value, range (sensitivity sweep), unit, reason (physical or declared engineering choice), fp1_tuned. Frozen with spec v1 2026-10-10; changes = dated amendments in docs/step5-plan.md section 13. Astra A0 review folded in (contradiction demotes by tier, inspection min_support, region geometry, reacquisition gate, budget share, FP1 dependency list).

H_location.reason: movable objects are moved by tasks and by people; a sighting is stale within a few episodes in a used kitchen

H_placement.reason: the agent's own put is usually followed by later tasks that move the same object again

H_negative.reason: absence after an inspection is the most fragile claim: any restock or task can falsify it

H_habit.reason: where a kitchen keeps a type (eggs in the fridge) changes slowly

H_lesson.reason: a remedy depends on geometry and detector, which change only with the map or the weights

H_procedure.reason: an executed action sequence stays valid while the action library is unchanged

gamma_contradiction.reason: one qualified contradiction halves the weight; the rank demotion itself is by tier (c=1 -> T2, c>=2 -> T3b below habits, spec 5.2), not by weight

reset_factor.reason: a reset re-spawns objects; the old location is only a 'maybe'

retire_below.reason: below 1/20 of a fresh claim the record is noise in a top-3 list; retired from retrieval, never deleted

w0.reason: verified > actuator-only > unverified; declared engineering choice

min_conf.reason: below this the step-3 detector's precision falls sharply; to be re-checked on held-out kitchens

task_vocabulary_source.value: sim/step5/lexicon/useful_types.json: AI2-THOR public pickupable/movable types intersected with the kitchen detector's declared class list (NOT derived from evaluation plans)
task_vocabulary_source.reason: R1 useful types from a predeclared public ontology (Astra A0 point 14)

vis_ok.reason: same as honest_skills.VIS_OK (step 4): most of the interior reached by depth rays

min_thirds.reason: same as step 4: a one-sided view hides half a shelf

max_range_m.reason: beyond about 1.5 m small kitchen objects fall to a few tens of pixels and the detector misses them

min_type_recall.unit: per-class recall on the sealed holdout
min_type_recall.reason: a negative is only meaningful for a type the detector usually finds

min_support.reason: same as honest_skills.VIS_MIN_SUPPORT (step 4): fewer probes cannot judge an interior

detector_capability._doc: Per kitchen detector, per type recall. To be filled in a later A stage from the step-3 sealed holdout (docs/fp1-detector-results.html, docs/kitchen-datasets.md). Until filled, NO type is capable -> no cross-task negatives (conservative). Detector-specific, so keyed by kitchen.
detector_capability.source: step-3 sealed holdout, FloorPlan1 two-stage detector

place_gate_m.reason: about half the receptacle's typical width: closer is the same box, farther is a neighbour

region_types.reason: large surfaces: depth-grounded points move > 0.4 m between views (step-4 open issue 1)

ambig_margin_m.reason: same as objmem.AMBIG_EPS: depth noise at 1-2 m

merge_gate_m.reason: two same-type places this close that were never co-seen are one box seen twice

depth_consistency_m.reason: an object on or in a receptacle sits within a hand-width of its surface depth

region_link_m.reason: grounded points on one counter run drift up to ~0.5 m between views; a gap wider than a stove/sink breaks the run

region_height_m.reason: one surface is one height; a different height is another surface (shelf vs counter)

placed_reacquire_m.reason: same as objmem.PLACED_GATE: a placed object may sit anywhere in the receptacle

prior_strength.reason: the fixed prior is worth two observations; declared

general_active.reason: one kitchen only; promote only with >= 2 kitchens and validate on a 3rd excluded kitchen

min_kitchens.reason: a transferable prior needs more than one kitchen (Astra review 4)

p0_unlisted.reason: a receptacle type the fixed prior does not list is possible but unlikely; declared

retire_margin.reason: declared engineering choice: two net failed reuses beyond demotion before retiring, so one unlucky reuse cannot retire a procedure
declared engineering choice: two net unhelpful units before retiring, so one bad application cannot retire a lesson

hypothesis_max_chars.reason: one short sentence; caps the leakage surface

default_action.reason: deterministic fallback when there is no Gemma hypothesis

audit_cap.reason: audit every lesson up to this many; above it, stratified sample (spec 7.6)

where_k.reason: small top-k for a 2B planner (Memp plateau-then-degrade)

budget_tokens.unit: Gemma tokens for the memory block
budget_tokens.reason: tuned together with k, not fixed by method (KareOne finding 2); swept on dev data only

persian_token_factor.unit: tokens per char relative to Latin
persian_token_factor.reason: measured in the KareOne RAG paper; fallback estimate only

channels.reason: dense only after the G-dense acceptance gate

where_share.reason: where_is lines go first; the rest is for procedures/lessons

a12.reason: A12, token-derived; B fixed by A16

K.reason: learning-curve checkpoints; the budget is locked on dev data

protocols.reason: exact-key procedure reuse is only possible on practised task concepts (Astra A0 point 13)

fp1_dependencies._doc: Artefacts tuned on or specific to FloorPlan1 that step 5 depends on (spec 5.3). Re-check before held-out kitchens.
value: step-3 two-stage detector weights + its per-class capability table
objmem geometry constants (ASSOC_GATE, PLACED_GATE, AMBIG_EPS, MISS_RANGE, OCCLUSION_TOL)
